author: daveops
content:
# Lessons from Five Years of On-Call

Five years of pager duty teaches you things no book can.

## Alerts must be actionable

If an alert fires and the first question is 'so what do I do?', the alert is broken. Every alert needs a runbook link.

## Runbooks rot

A runbook not updated after an incident is a liability. Build runbook review into your post-mortem template.

## 3 AM reveals your real architecture

Whatever breaks at 3 AM is your actual critical path, not what the architecture diagram says.

## Blameless post-mortems work

Teams that feel safe reporting failures fix more than teams that don't. The data is unambiguous.
title: Lessons from five years of on-call
